area: Stratford: Stratford Works sidings and GER main lines, Stratford Station and Eastern Junction, Stratford Goods Station, Angel Lane and Angel Lane Bridge, Angel Place, William Street, Western Street, Theatre Royal
method: 9 sweep crops at 2x; every candidate zoomed at 6x (+-40); digits confirmed at 10x (+-18) and 14x (+-12) where 8/9/6 ambiguous; pheons located at 6-10x.
legibility: Good but dense: rails, platforms and street lettering crowd many figures. No missing tiles. No sheet join detected by the tool and none seen (no straight tint step).
